credits_used.description: Premium AI credits consumed by the agent in this period (whole credits).

metrics_period_end_ms.description: End of the billing period (epoch ms, exclusive).

AgentPermissionsItem.description: A principal with its stored and workspace-resolved roles.

resolved_role.description: The effective role for this principal: the most permissive of the stored role and every other grant that reaches the principal — the workspace-wide grant and, for users, any granted group they belong to. Roles rank "view_and_interact" < "edit" < "full_access", so a user whose stored role is "edit" resolves to "full_access" when the workspace-wide grant allows "full_access". Grants that do not reach the principal are excluded: the workspace-wide grant reaches only full workspace members, and group grants reach only workspace members (never page guests or non-members, even if a stale group-member row still exists for them).

role.description: The role stored on this principal's agent permission item.

type.description: Indicates this user is a bot.

bot.description: Details about the bot, when the `type` of the user is `bot`.

expires_at.description: Unix time in milliseconds. Only individual workspace-member policies may expire.

CreateCreditLimitPolicySelector.description: All workspace members or one workspace member affected by the policy.

user_id.description: The ID returned by the workspace users API.

CreatorIds.description: IDs of members who created the tokens. Use bracket encoding for multiple values.

permissions.description: The page of permission entries, up to 250 per request. The workspace-wide grant always sorts first, then groups, then users.

next_cursor.description: Cursor to pass as cursor to fetch the next page; omitted on the last.
Cursor to pass as cursor on the next request to fetch the next page of agents; omitted when has_more is false.

GetAgentsCreditUsageOkResults.description: The page of agents with their credit usage, up to 100 agents per request. Every agent starts at its most recent billing period; a nested result's next_cursor paginates that agent's billing periods through the single-agent credit-usage endpoint.

export_job_id.description: Identifier of the export job, as returned by the enqueue endpoint.

download_urls.description: Short-lived, bot-scoped download URLs for the completed export. Always present when 'status' is 'completed', and absent for every other status.

GetSpaceExportStatusOkExportType.description: Whether an entire workspace ('space'), a teamspace, or a single 'page' was exported.

GetSpaceExportStatusOkStatus.description: Current state of the export: - 'in_progress': the export has not finished yet. - 'completed': the export finished and 'download_urls' is available. - 'url_generation_failed': the export finished, but a download URL could   not be generated. - 'failed': the export itself did not finish; see 'error_type' and   'error_message'.

GetWorkflowsMetadataForSpaceOkResults.description: The page of agents matching the filters, up to 100. Permanently deleted tombstones are excluded.

alive.description: Whether the agent is live (not soft-deleted). "false" for deleted agents, which are returned only when the "deleted" status filter is set.

status.description: The agent's current status: "active", "deleted", or a snake_case paused reason. Uses the same values as the status query filter.

created_by_table.description: The actor table of the agent's creator, such as "notion_user".

created_time.description: Epoch ms when the agent was created.

last_credit_usage_time.description: Epoch ms of the agent's most recent premium-credit usage; omitted if the agent has never consumed credits.

last_edited_by_table.description: The actor table of the agent's last editor, such as "notion_user".

last_edited_time.description: Epoch ms when the agent was last edited.

last_run_time.description: Epoch ms of the agent's most recent run; omitted if the agent has never run.

model.description: Human-readable model name, such as "Claude 4 Sonnet". Omitted when the agent is set to automatically choose a model, or when no display name is available.

moved_to_trash_time.description: Epoch ms when the agent was deleted; only present for deleted agents.

permissions.description: Who the agent is shared with: each principal's stored and resolved roles, workspace grant first, at most 250 entries. Omitted for database (autofill) agents, whose sharing state is not exposed.

GetWorkflowsMetadataForSpaceOkResultsIte.description: The capabilities and tools the agent is allowed to use — both inside Notion and in connected apps such as Slack, the web, or MCP servers. At most 250 module summaries are returned.
Summary of a module attached to an agent (which integration + its reach).

scopes.description: Distinct capability scopes granted to the module — the action verbs from its permission entries (e.g. Slack "read"/"write", GitHub "search", Notion "reader"/"editor"), aggregated across all resources for a quick overview.

GetWorkflowsMetadataForSpaceOkResultsIte.description: Per-resource access this module grants the agent, such as channels, pages, repositories, files, or MCP resources, and the actions allowed on each.
A resource, or set of resources, that a module grants the agent access to. This includes the resource kind when available, resource identifiers, and granted actions.

actions.description: Action verbs granted on these resources (read/write/search/editor/...).

ids.description: Opaque resource identifiers the agent can act on: Slack channel/user URIs, Notion page/collection ids, GitHub repos, Drive file ids, MCP resource URIs, or "*" for workspace-wide access.

kind.description: Resource discriminator when the module distinguishes kinds (Notion: "pageOrCollectionViewBlock" | "agent" | "workspacePublic" | "databaseProperty"; search: "web" | "helpdocs"; MCP: "tool" | "resource"). Omitted when the module has a single implicit resource kind.

GetWorkflowsMetadataForSpaceOkResultsIte.description: The table the agent is parented to: custom agents belong to the workspace ("space"); database (autofill) agents belong to their database's block ("block").

IncludeDeleted.description: Set to "true" to include soft-deleted agents and their retained credit usage; included deleted agents have status "deleted". Omit this parameter or set it to "false" to return only live agents. Permanently deleted tombstones are never returned.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null on the last page.

ListCreditLimitPoliciesOkResults.description: The active credit limit policies in the workspace.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Present only when 'has_more' is true.

revoked_at.description: Time the token was revoked, in epoch milliseconds.

revoked_by.description: User or bot that revoked the token.

ListPersonalAccessTokensOkResultsItemRev.description: Type of user or bot that revoked the token.

PersonPerson.description: Details about the person, when the `type` of the user is `person`.

status.description: Confirms that the user's active sessions were revoked.

Status.description: Token statuses to include. Use bracket encoding for multiple values.

Status2.description: Status filter. Accepts every response status value, plus the "disabled" convenience bucket for admin-disabled agents.

disable_existing_agents.description: When true, also disable all existing custom agents in the workspace. Only takes effect when policy is "disabled".

UpdateAgentCreationPolicyOkCurrentPolicy.description: The policy now in effect, or null when no explicit policy has ever been set for the workspace (which behaves as the "all_workspace_members" default).

credit_limit.description: The per-agent credit limit as a non-negative integer, or null to clear the limit.

credit_limit_by_workspace_admin.description: The workspace admin credit limit after the change, or `null` if no workspace admin limit applies.

enforced_credit_limit.description: The credit limit that applies to the agent after the change. This is the lower of the workspace admin limit and the limit set by the agent creator. The workspace default applies if neither limit is set. `null` means no limit applies.

current_credit_usage.description: The agent's credit usage in the current billing period, or `null` if the billing period is unknown.

did_clear_paused_state.description: Whether this change resumed the agent after a credit-limit or runaway-credit-usage pause.

is_active.description: Whether the agent is active after the change. `false` can mean this change paused the agent or that the agent was already paused for another reason.

permissions.description: The updated permission list, in the same shape as the read endpoint. This is a pre-commit projection truncated at 250 entries with no cursor; treat the paginated read endpoint as the source of truth.

UpdateAgentPermissionsRemoveItem.description: A recipient of a permission grant. "workspace" maps to a space-wide permission granting all workspace members the given role; guests are never covered by it.

UpdateAgentPermissionsSet.description: Principals to grant permissions to, or update the level for.

UpdateAgentPermissionsSetItem.description: A single upsert: grant principal the given role (creating or updating it).

admin_status.description: Set to "active" to re-enable an agent that was disabled through this API, or "disabled" to turn off a running agent.
The administrative status you set ("active" or "disabled"). This is the admin-disable toggle only; it does not tell you whether the agent will actually run.

UpdateAgentStatusOkPausedReason.description: The authoritative explanation for why an agent is paused (for example, "disabled_from_workspace_settings" or "workspace_credit_limit"). It is present only when run_status is "paused", and it is the field you must inspect to derive the agent's true state.

UpdateAgentStatusOkRunStatus.description: Whether the agent will actually run right now, independent of the admin-disable toggle. It reflects the agent's current state, including usage-based pauses such as a credit limit or workspace credit limit. It is "active" only when the agent has no paused reason and will actually run, and "paused" whenever a paused_reason is present, whether admin-set or not. Refer to paused_reason for why the agent is paused.

amount.description: Replacement monthly premium AI credit limit.

access.description: Access state applied to the member.

revoked_token_count.description: Number of active tokens revoked. Always zero when restoring access.

role.description: The user's new role in the group.

default_agent_credit_limit.description: Workspace-wide default agent credit limit, applied to agents going forward. Must be a non-negative whole number of credits; other values are rejected with a validation error. Use null to remove the workspace-wide default cap.
The workspace-wide default agent credit limit now in effect, or null when no default cap is set.
